migration.notes: Adds an explicit persistence choice for genuinely new users before identity onboarding. Existing persistent and legacy users retain their current startup path unchanged.

notes: First-Run Persistence Choice release. New users are no longer allowed to fall silently into session-only mode; they explicitly choose verified private cloud persistence or session-only operation before account identity intake.
features: mandatory first-run persistence decision before new-account identity intake
verified writable-provider cloud-workspace offer when storage is already exposed
connect-supported-storage or continue-session-only prompt when no writable provider is exposed
capability recheck after user reports storage connected
no persistence claim until private workspace read/write capability is verified
existing valid workspaces bypass redundant persistence prompts
read-only storage is not treated as canonical persistence
later enable persistence/connect storage path without account reset
